brute__root.title: Stomp
brute__root.description: Unlocks Stomp (Level 3) (60 mana, 23.94 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__root.extra_description: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path. The first skill of the Brute base.

brute__constitution_1.title: Constitution 1
brute__constitution_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

brute__combat_mastery_i.title: Combat Mastery I
brute__combat_mastery_i.description: Teaches Combat Mastery I, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Dodge in the middle of an attack, or attack straight out of a dodge. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

brute__renewal_mastery_i.title: Renewal Mastery I
brute__renewal_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

brute__planned_quake_slam.title: Seismic Slam
brute__planned_quake_slam.description: Unlocks Seismic Slam (35 mana, 18 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__planned_quake_slam.extra_description: A heavier stomp that also roots enemies in place for 2 s.

brute__buster_parade.title: Dread Full Buster
brute__buster_parade.description: Teaches Dread Full Buster, an Epic Fight Guard skill: Wind up your weapon for 1 to 2 s, then release a mighty blow that ignores guard and knocks out a target caught blocking or attacking. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

brute__time_debt.title: Time Debt
brute__time_debt.description: Unlocks Time Debt (Level 2) (47 mana, 134.66 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__time_debt.extra_description: For 30 seconds, take 50% of incoming mitigated damage immediately and borrow the other half. Over the following 30 seconds, repay 70% of that debt in six payments, five seconds apart. New damage is normal during repayment.

brute__wellspring_mastery_i.title: Wellspring Mastery I

brute__planned_javelin.title: Javelin Hurl
brute__planned_javelin.description: Unlocks Javelin Hurl (15 mana, 6 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__planned_javelin.extra_description: Throw your held spear; it pierces through the first target and flies back to your hand.

brute__planned_provoke.title: Provoke
brute__planned_provoke.description: Unlocks Provoke (20 mana, 25 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__planned_provoke.extra_description: Instead of a decoy goat, every mob nearby targets you and you gain Resistance I while it lasts.

brute__brave_aura.title: Brave Aura
brute__brave_aura.description: Unlocks Brave Aura (Level 3) (85 mana, 59.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__brave_aura.extra_description: Creates a moving aura that grants Brave to allies. The aura vanishes when its owner takes actual damage.

brute__halberd_strike.extra_description: Summons 3 frontal columns of phantom halberds to strike distant enemies.

brute__avatar_of_might.title: Avatar of Might
brute__avatar_of_might.description: Teaches Avatar of Might, an Epic Fight Identity skill: Hold sneak for 2 s to release a shockwave that pushes enemies away and makes you briefly immune to stuns. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

brute__vengeance.title: Vengeance
brute__vengeance.description: Teaches Vengeance, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Bonus damage against whoever last hurt you; killing them grants a fading damage boost. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

brute__combat_mastery_ii.title: Combat Mastery II
brute__combat_mastery_ii.description: Teaches Combat Mastery II, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Sprinting just after a dodge enters a Dash, which drains stamina while it lasts. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

brute__endurance.title: Endurance
brute__endurance.description: Teaches Endurance, an Epic Fight Passive skill: For up to 8 s, a hit while you prepare an attack costs stamina instead of stunning you. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

brute__halberd_horizon.title: Halberd Horizon
brute__halberd_horizon.description: Unlocks Halberd Horizon (Level 3) (94 mana, 29.93 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__halberd_horizon.extra_description: Summons Phantom Halberds in the battlefield around the caster, damaging entities caught in it. Can only be obtained by defeating Maledictus.

brute__fortify.title: Fortify
brute__fortify.description: Unlocks Fortify (Level 2) (76 mana, 179.55 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__fortify.extra_description: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

brute__ether_barrier.description: Unlocks Ether Barrier (Level 2) (76 mana, 89.78 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
brute__ether_barrier.extra_description: Creates a barrier that grants allies Ether, increasing knockback resistance, movement speed and cast speed.

brute__gavel_of_haima.title: Gavel of Haima

brute__gavel_of_haima.extra_description: Swings a giant glintstone hammer down on the ground ahead, hitting what it strikes directly and sending out a damaging shockwave.
